obligations.agency_full: Governor of the State of New York
obligations.action_summary: Appoint twenty-six members, with the advice and consent of the senate, to the public health and health planning council.
obligations.quote: There shall continue to be in the department a public health and health planning council to consist of the commissioner and twenty-six members to be appointed by the governor with the advice and consent of the senate.
obligations.law_title: Adds a representative of freestanding ambulatory surgery centers to the public health and health planning council

obligations.agency_full: Governor of the State of New York
obligations.action_summary: Appoint at least one council member representing freestanding ambulatory surgery centers, among other listed groups.
obligations.quote: at least one member shall be a representative of each of the following groups: women's health service providers, home care agencies, freestanding ambulatory surgery centers, diagnostic and treatment centers, health care payors, and labor organizations for health care employees.
obligations.law_title: Adds a representative of freestanding ambulatory surgery centers to the public health and health planning council

obligations.action_summary: Issue a congressional medal of honor license plate, on request, to recipients and now their spouses.
obligations.quote: Any congressional medal of honor recipient residing in this state or the spouse of any such recipient shall, upon request, be issued a license plate bearing the words "congressional medal of honor".
obligations.law_title: Relates to distinctive license plates issued to congressional medal of honor recipients

obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules requiring utility and cable television companies to trim vines on utility poles where growth is likely to disrupt safe and reliable service.
obligations.quote: On or before April first, two thousand twenty-four, the commission shall promulgate rules and regulations to require, in addition to other maintenance procedures, the trimming of vines on utility poles throughout the state
obligations.deadline_text: On or before April first, two thousand twenty-four
obligations.law_title: Requires vine trimming for the maintenance of utility poles

obligations.actor_raw: the treasury of the town of Cornwall
obligations.action_summary: Pay all hotel and motel tax revenues into the town treasury and credit them to the town's general fund.
obligations.quote: All revenues resulting from the imposition of the tax under the local laws shall be paid into the treasury of the town of Cornwall and shall be credited to and deposited in the general fund of the town.
obligations.law_title: Authorizes the town of Cornwall in Orange county to impose a hotel and motel tax; and provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof

obligations.action_summary: Pay occupancy tax revenues into the town treasury and credit them to the general fund.
obligations.quote: All revenues resulting from the imposition of the tax under the local laws shall be paid into the treasury of the town of Cortlandt and shall be credited to and deposited in the general fund of such town.
obligations.law_title: Authorizes the town of Cortlandt, in the county of Westchester, to levy an occupancy tax

obligations.action_summary: Establish an enforcement officer to oversee investigations of complaints of violations of the mandatory overtime limits.
obligations.quote: The department shall establish an enforcement officer to oversee investigations into any complaints of violations of this section.
obligations.law_title: Relates to the restrictions on consecutive hours of work for nurses

obligations.action_summary: Investigate complaints of mandatory overtime violations, in consultation with the department of health, and notify the employer.
obligations.quote: Upon receipt of a complaint pursuant to subdivision five of this section, the enforcement officer may cause such investigation to be made, in consultation with the department of health and shall notify the employer.
obligations.law_title: Relates to the restrictions on consecutive hours of work for nurses

obligations.action_summary: Develop and post on its website a poster telling employees how to file a complaint.
obligations.quote: The department shall develop and make available on its website a poster containing information for employees on filing a complaint pursuant to this section.
obligations.law_title: Relates to the restrictions on consecutive hours of work for nurses
